name: Mothers And Daughters
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility and blessing found in the relationship between mothers and daughters, highlighting the importance of honoring parents as commanded by God, which brings long life and well-being (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). Children are portrayed as a divine heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and the instruction and guidance given by both father and mother are vital for a child's spiritual formation (Proverbs 1:8). The Bible warns against dishonoring parents, linking it to spiritual darkness (Proverbs 20:20), and underscores the value of training children in godly ways so they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6).
